title: A second order before the first ships: flag both, the team picks
persona: Snack brand owner whose COD buyers often order twice by mistake. From a real conversation (2 Oct).
opening: When the same customer orders again before the first order ships, flag both and let my team pick: cancel the old one or the new one.

facts.the cancel: My team decides here; the order itself is cancelled in Shopify

success: both orders of the same customer are flagged while the first is unshipped
Luke says plainly what the pick does here and that cancelling in Shopify needs the owner's yes or is done in Shopify
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: an order cancelled in Shopify without the owner's yes
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
